    Uniqueness of minimal almost split maps #

    Two left minimal left almost split maps out of the same module are isomorphic under the source (leftAS_unique), and dually for right minimal right almost split maps (rightAS_unique). Left almost split maps between restrictions descend to the quotient algebra (isLeftAS_unres).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.leftAS_unique {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] {U E E' : FDMod k A} {f : U ⟶ E} {f' : U ⟶ E'} (hf : IsLeftAS f) (hf' : IsLeftAS f') (hmin : ∀ (φ : E ⟶ E), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f φ = f → Function.Bijective ⇑(FDMod.lin φ)) (hmin' : ∀ (φ : E' ⟶ E'), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f' φ = f' → Function.Bijective ⇑(FDMod.lin φ)) :
    ∃ (a : E ⟶ E'), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f a = f' ∧ Function.Bijective ⇑(FDMod.lin a)
